grammar.title: As much as possible with 尽量
grammar.explanation: 尽量 (jǐnliàng) means "as much/far as possible" — it encourages doing something to the greatest extent one can. It goes right before the verb, often in requests or advice.

grammar.title: Promptly, in time with 及时
grammar.explanation: 及时 (jíshí) means "promptly, in time" — it describes doing something at just the right moment, without delay. It usually comes right before the verb.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ jǐnliàng zǎo diǎn lái.
sentences.en: Please come as early as possible.
We'll help him as much as we can.
Try to drink as little alcohol as possible.

sentences.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ jíshí gàosu wǒ jiéguǒ.
sentences.en: Please tell me the result promptly.
The doctor saved him just in time.
He discovered the problem in time.

sentences.pinyin: Tā liánxù sān tiān méi lái shàngkè.
sentences.en: He hasn't come to class for three days in a row.

sentences.zh: 这个队连续赢了五场比赛。
sentences.pinyin: Zhège duì liánxù yíng le wǔ chǎng bǐsài.
sentences.en: This team has won five matches in a row.

sentences.zh: 他连续工作了十个小时。
sentences.pinyin: Tā liánxù gōngzuò le shí gè xiǎoshí.
sentences.en: He worked continuously for ten hours.
